name: ロール説明と複製操作を備えた管理ダイアログ
prompt:
Create a polished, compact, tall admin dialog image based closely on the supplied Jira “Manage roles” reference crop. Show a clean white modal with a thin neutral border and restrained soft neutral shadow on a white/off-white canvas. Keep the title “Manage roles” at the upper left and a simple neutral slate close X at the upper right. Show exactly these four role rows, with the role name above its description, in this order and with exact copy:
Administrator — “Admins can do most things, like update settings and add other admins.”
Member — “Members are part of the team, and can add, edit, and collaborate on all work.”
Viewer — “Viewers can search through, view, and comment on your team's work, but not much else.”
QA Reviewer — “Responsible for reviewing completed issues before they are marked as approved.”
Place one small neutral slate duplicate/copy outline icon at the right of each row. Only the QA Reviewer row also has a small semantic red trash/delete icon. At the bottom right place a white outlined secondary button “Close” and a primary button “Create role” with the official Lighthouse gradient at 135 degrees (#174C36 0%, #1F6444 58%, #2D8F5E 100%). Use ink #1D1D1D, secondary text #6E6E6E, neutral icons #526173, white surfaces, and simple spacing between rows. Keep the gradient only on the primary Create role action. No tint colors, tinted panels, color washes, glow, extra roles, additional descriptions, or extra controls. Preserve all copy exactly and do not add navigation.
reviewNotes: First candidate preserves the role copy and controls but its generated canvas is square, while the source dialog region is 763x658; excess vertical space changes the reference proportions. Superseded by compact v2.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
